name: Maiden of the Trench
source:
In a world of never-ending war, Britannian men and women are called upon to defend France against the Almanian invaders from the east. Resources are strained, casualties are mounting, and behind the scenes, leaders are becoming desperate.

Answering Queen Victoria II’s call, Alyssa and a handful of other women are sent to France with one simple mission: Save lives.

[From [url=https://longcatstudios.itch.io/maiden-of-the-trench]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个战火永无止息的世界里，布里塔尼亚的男男女女响应号召，奔赴法兰西抵御来自东方的阿尔曼尼亚侵略军。物资捉襟见肘，伤亡持续攀升，而在幕后，各国领袖也正变得愈发焦头烂额、不择手段。

响应维多利亚二世女王的号召，艾莉莎与寥寥数名女性被派往法兰西前线，肩负着一项纯粹的使命：拯救生命。

[摘自[url=https://longcatstudios.itch.io/maiden-of-the-trench]itch.io[/url]]
